P2 Interface Segregation. The freshness watchdog receives only a narrow bounded-recovery action and telemetry dependencies, not the full OutputTranscriptCache.

P2 Convention Drift. Regeneration uses existing event-store readers in read-only mode and constructs projections without a recovery writer; ordinary tests replay committed temporary SQLite fixtures and never open the developer database.

RuntimePosition is the only ordered receiver baseline; consistencyToken is a distinct non-null opaque content-generation token for every available window.
History, range, tool-body, and group-child reads use one reader and blockIdentity reaches both durable prefix and unflushed tail.

Overflow repairs only sessions whose patches were dropped, with one single-flight recovery per session and bounded fanout, while all existing frame caps and isOpened behavior remain unchanged.
